description: A lightweight, implementation-facing semantic skeleton for bounded Raft exploration.

sampling.rationale: Sample completed Ready batches and lifecycle changes without rewarding a search method for traversing host integration microsteps.

normalization.nodes: lexicographically minimal representation over all node permutations
normalization.terms: rank of non-zero term values; absolute term numbers are discarded
normalization.indexes: rank of non-zero log/frontier indexes; absolute index numbers are discarded
normalization.values: renamed by first appearance in each candidate canonical representation
normalization.event_ids: not part of the protocol state key
normalization.sender_epochs: not part of the protocol state key

limits.membership_transitions: v1 records voter relations but does not interpret joint-consensus phases
limits.snapshots: v1 records snapshot frontiers but does not reconstruct compacted entry contents
limits.integration_state: outstanding Ready and mailbox state are intentionally excluded from this protocol-level key
limits.measurement_window: the per-trace ledger includes bootstrap; cross-method evaluation must exclude or separately report the shared initialization prefix
